subject: S19 reopened: review19 CHANGES REQUESTED (20261117T111809-review19-601ae0). Decision: S19's queue approve is the only approval path
body: (1) HIGH: seg19 makes the seeder respect admin edits for questions and chapters like it does sections: admin_edited_at on questions/chapters set by trigger on non-seed writes, seed skips such rows unless --force, and never deletes admin-attached section_media (only seed-owned rows). Add db tests. (2)(3) HIGH: the publish gates use the sources licence tiers. Only storable licences publish (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA in its own partition, naadi-original, and NC tiers only if the owner confirms non-commercial). link-only, ND and NC-ND (StatPearls, usmle-official-samples, GeneReviews) can never publish stored content, whether PDFs, figures, questions or text. Add a table-driven test over every sources.yaml entry. (4) Answering S19's question 20261117T050009: S19's queue approve is the single path. seg15b removes /api/admin/generated/{id}/approve and the /admin/generated page and calls naadi_api.generation.approval only through S19's queue registry. seg15b does this in its current rework. (5) The authoring e2e must not skip: set the flags it needs in its own setup and restore them afterwards. Note: put the S19 commits on shared under S19-named messages from now on.
